rows.en: Yamato: "Hey, what should we do now?"
Ai: "Ow... Don't come out so suddenly!"
Touya: "Then why were you right in front of the door?"
Ai: "What's wrong with that? It's my hobby."
Touya: "If you don't need anything, I'll go..."
Touya: "Oh, did something happen to Kasumi?"
Ai: "I was hoping to ask a little about you and her, Touya..."
It's not really something to tell other people...
Touya: "Then, rather than standing around talking, want to come in?"
Touya: "Let's see... Where should I start...?"
Ai: "How long have you two known each other?"
Touya: "It was when I moved into my current house, so...
Touya: "When I was seven. Second grade."
Ai: "You remember well. I don't even remember
Touya: "I remember because I had trouble fitting in
She was the one who came and talked to me."
At that age, if you do that, you can end up ignored
or bullied along with them, right?"
Touya: "Yeah. But she didn't care about that.
She said she couldn't leave me alone."
Touya: "She's too nice for her own good.
Well, we were just kids. There wasn't any nasty bullying,
and through her, I soon fitted in with the class.
We lived next door to each other too,
and we've known each other ever since. Though there was a time
when we stopped seeing each other..."
Ai: "It's the usual pattern. You always went to and from school together,
and something you'd taken for granted and never thought about
suddenly made you self-conscious when classmates teased you."
Ai: "You stopped seeing each other because you avoided her.
Touya: "...Yeah. We ended up in different classes too.
Until we were in the same class again in junior high."
Touya: "After that... My mom and dad died in a terrorist attack..."
you and I met, Touya, right?"
Yamato: "You found me when I'd only just been born, Touya,
and we've been together ever since."
Maybe having you and Kasumi there
kept me from giving in to despair."
Yamato: "What's with the sudden speech? You're embarrassing me."
Touya: "Come to think of it, that's when Kasumi started
fussing over me even more than before..."
Touya: "Well, one thing led to another, we ended up at the same high school,
Ai: "Somehow, it feels like her whole life revolves around you, Touya...
Ai: "Well, I'm sure that's what she wants, but...
have you done anything for her?"
Ai: "Like... taking her on a date."
Ai: "No, never mind. That reaction tells me pretty much everything.
I see. She's got it tough too... Mm-hmm."
Touya: "Hey, what are you deciding all by yourself?"
Ai: "All right! I've still got a chance, then.
Yamato: "At the very least, a love triangle
has definitely formed as of this moment."
Yamato: "Though the problem is that the person at its apex doesn't realize it.
Ai: "Aww! What's the harm? It's not like you'll lose anything."
Touya: "If you want to know that badly, ask Kasumi.
It's her business too. I can't just go
blabbing about it without asking her."
Ai: "Hmm... At least you're proper about that sort of thing. More or less."
Touya: "You can leave out 'more or less.'"
Ai: "Well, in that case, I'll respect your wishes
Touya: "I don't really get it, but thanks."
Ai: "But... Can I ask just one thing?"
Ai: "Have you ever gone on a date with her?"
Yamato: "At the very least, a love triangle
has definitely formed as of this moment."
Yamato: "Though the problem is that the person at its apex doesn't realize it.
